create_table:
CREATE TABLE assignment_submissions (
  submitted_at timestamp without time zone,
  feedback text,
  file_url text,
  grade numeric,
  student_id uuid,
  assignment_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE assignments (
  course_id uuid,
  title text,
  description text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  due_date timestamp without time zone,
  faculty_id uuid,
  total_marks numeric DEFAULT 100,
  id uuid NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE attendance_ping_logs (
  id bigint NOT NULL,
  session_id uuid,
  student_id uuid,
  device_hash text,
  bssid text,
  signal_strength integer,
  ping_time timestamp with time zone DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE attendance_records (
  session_id uuid,
  avg_signal_strength numeric,
  duration_minutes numeric,
  last_seen_at timestamp without time zone,
  first_seen_at timestamp without time zone,
  calculated_at timestamp without time zone,
  status USER-DEFINED,
  ping_count integer,
  student_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE courses (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  description text,
  name text NOT NULL,
  code text UNIQUE
);

CREATE TABLE faculty (
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  designation text,
  honorarium_rate_per_hour numeric,
  years_experience integer,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  department text,
  photo_url text
);

CREATE TABLE feedback_questions (
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  question text NOT NULL,
  category text,
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  type USER-DEFINED,
  active boolean
);

CREATE TABLE feedback_responses (
  text_answer text,
  rating integer,
  session_id uuid,
  yes_no boolean,
  student_id uuid,
  submitted_at timestamp without time zone,
  question_id uuid,
  id uuid NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE notifications (
  sent_by uuid,
  is_read boolean,
  session_id uuid,
  title text NOT NULL,
  type text NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  recipient_id uuid,
  message text NOT NULL,
  course_id uuid,
  created_at timestamp without time zone
);

CREATE TABLE session_materials (
  content text,
  uploaded_by uuid,
  session_id uuid,
  file_url text,
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  course_id uuid,
  faculty_id uuid,
  title text,
  file_type text,
  created_at timestamp without time zone
);

CREATE TABLE sessions (
  start_time time without time zone NOT NULL,
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  course_id uuid,
  faculty_id uuid,
  venue_id uuid,
  session_date date NOT NULL,
  end_time time without time zone NOT NULL,
  status USER-DEFINED,
  created_by uuid,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  title text NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE students (
  program_name text,
  mac_address text,
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  mac_verified boolean,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  enrollment_no text,
  device_hash text,
  photo_url text
);

CREATE TABLE system_settings (
  attendance_window integer,
  id integer NOT NULL,
  ping_interval integer,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  pings_per_session integer,
  presence_threshold integer
);

CREATE TABLE users (
  is_active boolean,
  email text NOT NULL,
  password_hash text NOT NULL,
  first_name text,
  last_name text,
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  role USER-DEFINED NOT NULL,
  updated_at timestamp without time zone,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  preferences jsonb DEFAULT '{}'
);

CREATE TABLE venues (
  name text NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamp without time zone,
  id uuid NOT NULL,
  building text,
  router_bssid text,
  is_active boolean
);
